question: **Direction: Sentences with spelling errors are given. Select the sentence with NO error.**

options.text: The psycologists who are a major part of the investigasion interviewed the witnesses.
The psychologists who are a major part of the investigasion interviewed the witneses.
The psycologists who are a major part of the investigation interviewed the witneses.
The psychologists who are a major part of the investigation interviewed the witnesses.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The psychologists who are a major part of the investigation interviewed the witnesses."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence **"The psychologists who are a major part of the investigation interviewed the witnesses"** is correct because it has proper spelling and grammar.
 
• There are no spelling errors in the words **"psychologists," "investigation,"** or **"witnesses,"** and the sentence is grammatically sound.
 
• In contrast, the other sentences contain various spelling errors, such as** "psycologists," "investigasion," **and** "witneses."**
 
• The word **"psychologists" **means scientists who study the mind and the way that people behave. (व्‍यक्तियों के मन और व्‍यवहार की रीति का अध्ययन करने वाला वैज्ञानिक; मनोविज्ञानी)
 
 
• **Example**: *Research **psychologist**__s normalize the results of their studies by comparing their subjects' behaviour with that of the general public.*
 
 
 
• The word **"investigation" **means an official examination of the facts about a situation, crime, etc. (किसी स्थिति, अपराध आदि से संबंधित तथ्‍यों की आधिकारिक जाँच, अन्‍वेषण कार्य, छान-बीन, तफ़तीश, तहक़ीक़ात)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The airlines are going to carry out an **investigation**__ into security procedures at airports.*
 
 
 
• The word** "witnesses"** means persons who seessomething happen and who can tell other people about it later. (घटना का साक्षी; गवाह)
 __
 
• **Example**:* There were two **witnesses**__ to the accident.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
